content_html:
Cusco is famous for Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley, but it is also home to lesser-known experiences that will allow you to explore its culture, nature and adventures in a different way. If you are looking to escape the traditional tourist circuits, here you go the best not so well known tours in Cusco.

1. Trek to Waqrapukara

Located on top of a cliff, this impressive archaeological complex in the shape of horns is ideal for trekking lovers. The route offers spectacular views of the Andes and a mystical atmosphere away from the crowds.

2. Adventure at Perolniyoc Falls

This tour takes you to an impressive waterfall surrounded by nature. Along the way, you can also visit the ruins of Raqaypata and enjoy a day of disconnection in the Andean landscapes.

3. Trekking to Humantay Lagoon

Although increasingly popular, this turquoise lagoon remains a hidden gem for those seeking a closer contact with nature. Its location at more than 4,200 m a.s.l. makes it a challenging but rewarding experience.

4. The Ccarañahui Caves

Located on the road to Abancay, these caves contain unique rock formations with calcium crystals that create a fascinating underground landscape. They are a different option for curious explorers.

5. The Pampachiri Stone Forest

This site, similar to a landscape from another planet, has rock formations in the shape of volcanic cones. It is an ideal place for lovers of photography and geology.

6. Tour to the Lares Thermal Baths

If you are looking for relaxation, the Lares thermal baths are the perfect option. These natural waters, rich in minerals, are surrounded by mountains and a calm environment.

7. Experience at the Cóndores de Chonta Viewpoint

From this viewpoint, you can observe the majestic flight of the Andean condor in its natural habitat. It is an excellent alternative for those seeking an authentic connection with the local fauna.

8. Explore Killarumiyoc Ruins

This Inca ceremonial center is dedicated to the moon and is a place full of mysticism. Few tourists visit it, which allows you to explore it in peace.

9. Route of the 4 Lagoons

This circuit runs through the Pomacanchi, Acopia, Asnaqocha and Pampamarca lagoons. It is ideal for those who enjoy the tranquility of the water and impressive landscapes.

10. Tour to Palccoyo, the Alternative to Vinicunca

If you want to enjoy a mountain of colors without the crowd of Vinicunca, Palccoyo is the best option. The walk is shorter and the scenery is just as impressive.

Conclusion

Cusco is much more than its most touristic sites. These alternative experiences will allow you to discover the hidden magic of the region, connect with nature and live unique adventures away from the crowds.
